SELECT t.id, t.rule_id, t.assignee_id, t.store_id, t.title, t.content, t.link, t.object_key, t.due_date, t.status, t.done_by, t.done_time, t.create_time, t.update_time, r.name AS rule_name, u.nickname AS assignee_name, s.name AS store_name FROM ecom_auto_todo t LEFT JOIN ecom_auto_rule r ON r.id = t.rule_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = t.store_id
AND t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status = #{status} AND (t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.due_date, t.id DESC
